uploadDescription: Your font and text stay on this device.
dropTitle: Drop a font here or click to browse
textDescription: Include every character your site needs, including punctuation and spaces. Repeated characters are counted once.
textPlaceholder: Paste the text that will use this font…
preserveNote: Keeps layout features, hinting and variable font axes.
noReduction: No size reduction for this selection
previewDescription: Rendered with the generated font. Missing characters use a fallback font.
previewError: This browser could not preview the generated font. You can still download it.
cssDescription: Place both downloaded files in the same folder. Apply the generated font-family to your text.
missingTitle: Some characters are missing from the source font
missingDescription: The subset cannot add these characters. Use another font or a fallback for them.
invalidFont: Choose a valid TTF, OTF, WOFF or WOFF2 font. Font collections are not supported; export a single font first.
emptyText: Enter the text you want to keep.
noCharacters: This font contains none of the requested characters. Try different text or another font.
generationError: The font could not be processed. Try another font file.
workerError: The font processor could not start. Reload the page and try again.
